name: Cyber Clock (StickS3)
description: Cyberpunk desk clock for M5StickS3: NTP timekeeping, a column-trail digital-rain engine with 6 character sets, 6 neon palettes, 40-band microphone spectrum, IMU shake-to-theme and a three-stage power save (60 s down-clock, 180 s Light Sleep with button wake). | M5StickS3 赛博朋克桌面时钟：NTP 自动对时、6 种字符集的列轨迹数字雨、6 套霓虹配色、40 段麦克风频谱、摇一摇换主题，以及三段式省电（60 秒降频 / 180 秒 Light Sleep + 按键唤醒）。
author: andjiang0083

versions.change_log: First public release. Three display modes, six rain character sets, six themes, timezone picker, microphone spectrum, and a fixed long-press double-trigger. Cardputer build reaches feature parity.

name: Cyber Clock (Cardputer)
description: Cyberpunk desk clock for M5Cardputer: the same 240x135 clock with physical-keyboard controls, NTP timekeeping, column-trail digital rain with 6 character sets, 6 neon palettes, 40-band microphone spectrum and IMU shake-to-theme. Power save down-clocks to 80 MHz + 1 fps (no Light Sleep: the keyboard sits behind an I2C expander). | M5Cardputer 赛博朋克桌面时钟：同一块 240x135 时钟，改用物理键盘操作；NTP 自动对时、6 种字符集的列轨迹数字雨、6 套霓虹配色、40 段麦克风频谱、摇一摇换主题。省电降频到 80MHz + 1fps（无 Light Sleep：键盘挂在 I²C 扩展芯片后面）。
author: andjiang0083

versions.change_log: First public release. Keyboard controls (S/R/C/W/+/-), timezone picker, microphone spectrum, IMU shake-to-theme, and the same rain engine and palettes as the StickS3 build.
